package: Order-Ten Harmonic-Tail Reconstruction and Polylogarithmic Stieltjes Generators

claims.statement: For every integer 6 <= b <= 1919, det(M_{5,b}) is nonzero.
claims.proof: One-prime modular certificate, direct source matrices for b=6..9 and exact retained 5x5 matrices for b=10..1919, with denominator safety and two full replays.

claims.statement: For every integer b >= 6, det(M_{5,b}) is nonzero; hence the smaller-order-ten optimal-prefix family has full formal rank.
dependencies: inherited effective eventual rank for b >= 1920

claims.statement: For every b >= 6 and 0 <= k < b, an explicit rationally computable ordinary O(n^-2) series reconstructs zeta(2k) from A_10(n) A_{2b}(n), equivalently from a product of polygamma functions.
The generating function of A_p(n)A_q(n) is a divided expression in depth-two multiple polylogarithms and has a Gamma-normalized double Mellin representation.
claims.proof: Absolute min-index decomposition and Mellin summation.

claims.statement: A holomorphic pole-subtracted bivariate depth-two multiple-polylogarithm kernel generates all products gamma_r(n+1)gamma_s(n+1).
claims.proof: Singular-order regularization of the two-tail generator plus local normal convergence.

claims.statement: The digamma-square generating function has the displayed anchored primitive and explicit value at z=1/2.
The displayed degree-30 (10,16) identity reconstructs zeta(2).
The optimal-prefix conjecture for every unequal even pair 2a < 2b remains open uniformly in a.
No claim of global literature priority is made for the analytic generator formulas.
